column1: # Lesson demand ratchet per level (#633, #655), checked by `kabar-tools demand --check` in CI.

# level<TAB>max % of listen items with only Arabic options<TAB>max % of multiple-choice items with only Arabic options<TAB>min words per listening text<TAB>max % of listen items where the longest option is the answer<TAB>max % of multiple-choice items where the longest option is the answer
# `-` is no limit (Javanese levels carry only the longest-option columns). Aim for the longest-option columns: under 40.
# A batch that improves a level tightens its line in the same PR; never loosen one.
